name: crew-chief
description: Difficulty-based routing for Claude Code. You pick the main model and effort; Claude decides what to do itself and what to hand to tiered Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus subagents, escalates when a tier gets stuck, and follows your overrides like "do it yourself" or "give this to Sonnet at medium".

default_mode.title: Default delegation mode
default_mode.description: auto routes by difficulty, solo keeps all work in the main session, delegate hands independent work to subagents. Switch any time with /crew-chief:crew-mode.
